meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For **acne-prone skin**, I’d prioritize **salicylic acid (1–2%)** if your main issue is active pimples, blackheads, clogged pores, or oily skin.

### My top picks under ₹700

### [The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum]()
*₹314*

### [Chemist At Play 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹255*

### [Pilgrim Oil Control Serum]()
*₹248*

### [Gabit 5% Azelaic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹495*

**🥇 Best overall: The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide** — around **₹314–₹449** depending on seller. It combines **2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide**, making it a good choice if you have both active acne and post-acne marks. The brand currently lists the 30 ml bottle at ₹449. [thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/products/sali-cinamide-anti-acne-serum-with-2-salicylic-acid-5-niacinamide-30ml?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 Best simple BHA: Chemist At Play 2% Salicylic Acid** — around **₹255**. I'd choose this if your biggest concern is **clogged pores, blackheads and recurring pimples** and you don't need a complicated formula.

**🥉 Good for oily skin: Pilgrim Oil Control Serum** — around **₹248**. It has a strong review base in the current shopping results and is a budget-friendly option.

**For acne marks/redness more than active acne:** consider **Gabit 5% Azelaic Acid**. Azelaic acid is particularly useful for inflammation and post-acne pigmentation, although 5% is relatively gentle.  

### What I'd buy
If you haven't used an acne serum before, **get The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide**. It's the most versatile of these options.

**How to start:** use 2–3 nights/week on dry skin, then moisturize. Don't start by combining it with other exfoliating acids or retinoids. Wear **SPF 30–50 every morning**.

If you tell me whether your skin is **oily, dry, combination, or sensitive**, and whether you mainly have **active pimples, blackheads, or acne marks**, I can narrow it down to **one specific serum**.
